title: The worst job interview I ever had
summary: A personal blog post recounting a particularly bad job interview experience where the candidate was subjected to 8 hours of interviews, unpaid take-home work, and inappropriate questions about personal life and political views.
problem_solved: This article documents a problematic hiring experience that serves as a cautionary tale about toxic interview processes and what job seekers should watch out for.
why_valuable: The article resonated with 374+ HN readers because it highlights common red flags in technical hiring and provides a shared experience for professionals to learn from.
